author: Bobby Grayson
description: Found by my own two malformed fixtures. The fixtures step was written as a pipeline: run_fixtures.exs | grep -v PASS. run_fixtures.exs does System.halt(1) when a fixture fails, but with set -e a pipeline takes its status from the LAST command, and grep succeeded, so check.sh printed two FAIL lines and went on to report every later stage green and exit 0. Fixed by running the suite into a scratch file and checking its status, which keeps the same output shape. The same shape is worth auditing elsewhere in the file: the BEAM drivers are all , so a driver that halts non-zero is swallowed the same way -- but those drivers signal by printing OK lines rather than by exit status, so it is a smaller hole than this one was.
title: check.sh reported a failing fixture and stayed green
